card.name: Words introducing adverse-event reports
card.fires_on: Words that introduce or sit inside reports of adverse events or warnings, such as 'of' after 'Postmarketing reports', 'been' in 'There have been reports', and the ends of words like MORTALITY and suicidality.

modes.label: Report-introducing words
modes.description: Linking words or 'reports' in phrases about postmarketing or spontaneous reports.
modes.example: There have<< been>> reports of reddish stools in patients receiving

modes.label: Ends of risk words
modes.description: The last piece of a long risk or safety word in a heading or risk sentence.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED MORTAL<<ITY>> IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH

card.plain: It fires on wording that sets up a report of a side effect or a warning, just before the event is named.
